g.text: GAS EXPORT COMPRESSOR VER 1 · OPERATOR TRAINING SIMULATOR
GAS EXPORT COMPRESSOR K-100 — TWO SECTIONS, GT-100 DRIVER
1. Flags: OTS design state (200 MMSCFD, PIC-101 30.0 barg → SIC-100 speed; UV-103, UV-108, PV-102 shut). Pressures in barg.
2. K-100 sections 1 and 2: one casing, one shaft, direct drive by GT-100. UV-103/UV-108 recycle cooled gas (anti-surge).
3. Relief, blowdown, vent and bypass lines (PSV-001, PV-102, BDV-101/112, HV-101/102) drawn light. Trips and line sizes: P&ID KC-PID-100.
4. Symbol sizes indicative. Flare KO drum and stack on PID-900 (tag V-900 assumed). Fuel-gas skid and seawater CM cooler not shown.
